# Tech&Res politics: pole rules of the tier ideologies - GENERATED by scripts/politics/ztrpol_gen_tier_ideologies.py, do not edit by hand

# Interest group: replace its social tier ideology with $IDEOLOGY$
ztrpol_tier_set_social = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_ideology = ideology:$IDEOLOGY$
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_extreme_traditionalist
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_extreme_traditionalist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate_traditionalist
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_moderate_traditionalist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate_progressist
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_moderate_progressist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_extreme_progressist
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_extreme_progressist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoliberal_progressist
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_neoliberal_progressist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_socialist_vigilance
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_ztrpol_socialist_vigilance
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ztrpol_national_vigilance
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_ztrpol_national_vigilance
		}
		add_ideology = $IDEOLOGY$
	}
}

# Interest group: replace its environmental tier ideology with $IDEOLOGY$
ztrpol_tier_set_env = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_ideology = ideology:$IDEOLOGY$
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neg_ambientalist
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_neg_ambientalist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate_ambientalist
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_moderate_ambientalist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_extreme_ambientalist
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_extreme_ambientalist
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoliberal_ambientalist
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_neoliberal_ambientalist
		}
		add_ideology = $IDEOLOGY$
	}
}

# Interest group: no environmental tier ideology
ztrpol_tier_clear_env = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neg_ambientalist
		}
		remove_ideology = ideology_neg_ambientalist
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate_ambientalist
		}
		remove_ideology = ideology_moderate_ambientalist
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_extreme_ambientalist
		}
		remove_ideology = ideology_extreme_ambientalist
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoliberal_ambientalist
		}
		remove_ideology = ideology_neoliberal_ambientalist
	}
}

# Interest group (vanilla): social tier ideology for the tier, pole and core of its country; base table without pole or with the pole hook off
ztrpol_tier_apply_social = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_social_ideology_tier = 1
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_extreme_traditionalist }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_social_ideology_tier = 2
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_extreme_traditionalist }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_social_ideology_tier = 3
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_collectivist_core = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_extreme_traditionalist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes
					}
				}

				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_progressist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_progressist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_core = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_progressist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_progressist }
			}
			else = {
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_extreme_progressist }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_social_ideology_tier = 3
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_collectivist_core = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_ztrpol_socialist_vigilance }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_progressist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_core = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_progressist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_progressist }
			}
			else = {
				ztrpol_tier_set_social = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_extreme_progressist }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Interest group (vanilla): environmental tier ideology, as above
ztrpol_tier_apply_env = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 1
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_clear_env = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 2
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_clear_env = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 3
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_clear_env = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 1
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 2
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 3
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_core = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
			}
			else = {
				ztrpol_tier_clear_env = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 1
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_clear_env = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 2
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 3
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 1
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 2
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 3
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_collectivist_core = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_core = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neg_ambientalist }
			}
			else = {
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_neoliberal_ambientalist }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 1
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
		}
		else_if = {

					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 2
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					var:ztr_env_ideology_tier = 3
				}
			}
			ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {

						ztrpol_is_collectivist_core = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_collectivist_pole = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_core = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_pole = yes
					}
				}
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_moderate_ambientalist }
			}
			else = {
				ztrpol_tier_set_env = { IDEOLOGY = ideology_extreme_ambientalist }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {

# Country, from the ztr_apply_*_ideologies tier effects: tier ideologies of the vanilla interest groups
ztrpol_tier_apply_social_all = {
	ig:ig_landowners ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_social = yes
	}
	ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_social = yes
	}
	ig:ig_devout ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_social = yes
	}
	ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_social = yes
	}
	ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_social = yes
	}
	ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_social = yes
	}
	ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_social = yes
	}
	ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_social = yes
	}
}

ztrpol_tier_apply_env_all = {
	ig:ig_landowners ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_env = yes
	}
	ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_env = yes
	}
	ig:ig_devout ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_env = yes
	}
	ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_env = yes
	}
	ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_env = yes
	}
	ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_env = yes
	}
	ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_env = yes
	}
	ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
		ztrpol_tier_apply_env = yes
	}
}

# Country, yearly after ztrpol_ig_ideology_yearly: once the pole is stable, each IG off its target tier ideology realigns with a yearly chance
ztrpol_tier_realign_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
			has_variable = ztrpol_pole_years
			var:ztrpol_pole_years >= 4
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
				is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
				is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_variable = ztr_social_ideology_tier
					}
					ztrpol_tier_social_aligned = no
				}
				random = {
					chance = 15
					ztrpol_tier_apply_social = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_variable = ztr_env_ideology_tier
					}
					ztrpol_tier_env_aligned = no
				}
				random = {
					chance = 15
					ztrpol_tier_apply_env = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
